description_zh: Pony.ai AV 因红灯停在最右侧车道准备右转，后方丰田卡罗拉（ego）快速驶来，先急停再蠕行最后猛冲追尾，碰撞时 ego 车速约 5 mph（2.2 m/s），测试 ego 在跟车与注意力分散情况下能否避免碰撞。

source_snippets: The Pony.ai autonomous vehicle ("Pony.ai AV") was stopped for approximately 3 minutes at the red light in the far right lane on Milmont Dr. preparing to turn right onto Dixon Landing Rd.

While stopped, Vehicle 2 came up quickly immediately behind the Pony.ai AV then proceeded to stop abruptly. Vehicle 2 then proceeds to creep up towards the Pony.ai with the driver of Vehicle 2 appearing to look down. Vehicle 2 then lurches forward quickly towards the Pony.ai AV.
The Pony.ai AV was stopped at 0 mph, while the approximate speed of Vehicle 2 at the point of collision was 5 mph.
TYPE OF COLLISION: VEH 2: A. HEAD-ON (X), MOVEMENT PRECEDING COLLISION: VEH 1: A. STOPPED (X), VEH 2: B. PROCEEDING STRAIGHT (X)
evidence.reason: 选择后方移动的 Vehicle 2 作为 ego，Pony.ai AV 作为同车道前方静止 NPC，使用 rear_hit 行为原语，因描述为追尾事故，控制信号为 traffic_light，天气与时间从报告提取。
